description: Remembered the landlady's old verdict on the comedy, and was told to let it lie.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Sent him off without a speech about the price.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Said the close had been quiet on the way to the loom.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Said he was in the comedy, and that he would want supper rather than dinner.
name: William Shakespeare
